lines.text: Jesus sends the disciples ahead in the boat, dismisses the crowds, and goes up on the mountain to pray alone.
During the fourth watch, Jesus walks on the sea toward the wind-beaten boat, and the disciples think He is a ghost.
Peter asks to come to Jesus on the water, walks toward Him, then fears the rain and begins to sink.
Jesus takes hold of Peter, the wind dies down in the boat, and the disciples call Him the Prophet of God.
At Gennesaret, people bring all the sick to Jesus, and all who touch the fringe of His cloak are healed.
